title: V — Multi-domain value vector (q_speace_economy §4.4.1)
description: 4-component value vector (E_x, S_gen, I_c, R_b) plus optional 5th coherence component. The vector is the input to the VTEC controller.

S_gen.description: Entropy generation per unit time (watts per kelvin).

coherence_phi.description: Optional 5th component: global coherence phase in [0,1]; used by VTEC to weight the objective.
